meta.source: Canmore — the National Record of the Historic Environment
meta.note: Canmore records for classes abandoned by definition: wartime structures including bunkers, control rooms and air raid shelters, and deserted townships. Only records positioned to 1 or 10 metres and flagged as covering a built structure. Every remaining record page was then read. Entries whose text confirms remains survive are shown by default. Entries whose text says the site was demolished or left no trace are excluded entirely. Entries that say nothing either way are kept as a separate Condition unknown layer, off by default: some are intact bunkers, some are empty fields, and Canmore does not say which. Canmore is an archive, not a condition survey.
